verdict.rationale: Call recording is a fair question for a business phone system like RingCentral, so the axis applies. The pack never documents call recording, consent announcements or jurisdiction-based consent rules, or retrieval of recordings. Call-log reading, visual voicemail and conversational AI insights are adjacent features and do not show recordings with consent handling.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later
